youtube.titulo: Fence posts in concrete? Don't build this cup
youtube.descripcion:
Setting a wood post in a full concrete "cup" traps water at the ground line — exactly where rot starts. Six inches of gravel under the post, concrete around it (never under it), and a sloped top fix it.

For general education only. Building codes vary by location — check your local code and a licensed professional before you build.

tiktok.texto: Setting fence posts in concrete? If the concrete goes UNDER the post, you built a cup 😬 Gravel first, concrete around, slope the top. How did you set yours?

facebook.texto: Setting fence posts in concrete? Most people pour it under the post too — and that's exactly why posts rot at the ground. How did you set yours? 👇
